verdict.rationale: Qapita's own docs say the platform manages stock option exercises globally (qapita-docs-7) and serves as an equity source of truth for employees (qapita-docs-4, qapita-docs-8). Nothing describes an employee-initiated online exercise flow, payment handling, or automatic share issuance. missing for 10: an employee self-service online exercise workflow, in-platform exercise payment, automated share issuance or cap table update after exercise, evidence of a paperless process (e-signature or no forms), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
